stories.title: Qualify AWS Agent eligibility and shared architecture-review contracts
stories.outcome: Teams can tell which architecture-review operations are supported, what input they require and why live activation is blocked, without buying Support or guessing provider behavior.
stories.files: Shared contracts/v1 catalog, schemas, OpenAPI, operation/MCP matrices and compatibility fixtures; L5 run_input/configuration registration; proposed adapters/well_architected qualification fixtures and docs. Coordinate common edits with #8683 and DevOps PR #9081; no platform constants.
stories.contract: Register proposed well_architected/architecture_review as typed service/capability variants; mixed immutable document/repository_commit inputs, five supported Agent pillars and source_only mode. Record current SDK model hash, exact Support/region/source-size/additionalContext/role/readback semantics and safe no-effect/reconciliation rules. Native Start has no client token in the inspected model; local timeout is not cancellation. Public requests cannot carry authority or arbitrary SDK arguments. Existing Security/DevOps callers remain compatible.
stories.prerequisite: Eligible private provider fixture and authoritative Module/Feature catalog mapping are unverified. WA01 records qualification evidence; WA07 supplies eligible access; PranavSharma1000 resolves catalog IDs. Live contract qualification/activation and dependent dispatch are affected, not independent schema work.

checks.setup: Given selected eligible and ineligible private fixtures, run only the admitted provider qualification procedure.
checks.assertion: Record current region/Support/source/API limits and exact affected-capability reason; denied IAM is not misreported as Support status; no purchase or unrequested resource is created.
checks.evidence: Versioned qualification table, official model/doc revision and redacted native positive/negative responses plus resource readback.
checks.phase: Before review: table/schema; live qualification: WA01 with WA07 fixture

checks.setup: Given current SDK shapes and scripted lost Start responses, missing/list-delayed/multiple matches and unsupported stop, qualify recovery decisions.
checks.assertion: No nonexistent clientToken/stop call; only a unique attributable generation reconciles. Zero matches are not no-effect proof; local expiry is distinct from native state. Current live readback limits are explicit.
checks.evidence: SDK/model fixtures, independent provider call-count assertions and qualified native identity/read-consistency record.
checks.phase: Before review + live semantics: WA01; integration WA04/WA07

checks.setup: Given WA and existing Security/DevOps payloads, validate all shared client/schema variants and catalog references.
checks.assertion: Valid mixed pinned sources pass; unknown fields, resource inspection, unsupported pillars and authority overrides fail. Existing fixtures still pass; unmapped catalog IDs remain explicitly unresolved before dispatch.
checks.evidence: Contract validator output, negative fixtures, operation parity matrix and authoritative catalog mapping or scoped block.

stories.title: Configure and create or adopt source-only Agent Profile bindings
stories.outcome: Users can save selected architecture inputs and pillars, then explicitly create or adopt an Agent Profile without enabling unwanted resource discovery or deleting customer-owned setup.
stories.files: Existing L5 configuration_population/readiness, api/configuration, api/bindings, models/setup and workers/bindings; proposed adapters/well_architected/binding.py; gateway l5_integration service authorization. Coordinate shared setup/broker owners #8684/#8686 and WA07.
stories.contract: Profile/source APIs supply authorized candidates; preserve overrides and conditional handoff on refresh. POST binding-operations selects create/link/check with pinned config and current connection. Persist stable setup token, exact native identity and ownership receipt separately from finite runs. Source-only requires aggregationConfiguration=[], qualified execution role, pillars and no unwanted native contexts/scheduled discovery. Readiness distinguishes eligibility, input and authority. Adopt never mutates/deletes foreign or customer-owned setup; serialize profile/source changes with active runs.
stories.prerequisite: WA01 qualifies native source-only setup/trust and eligibility. Approved selected connection/role/store comes from WA07 under existing authority; no IAM/billing change authorized by this story filing. Catalog IDs remain WA01/coordinator-owned.

checks.setup: Given two Profile revisions and explicit source/pillar overrides, save and refresh configuration then check readiness.
checks.assertion: Overrides and immutable provenance survive, stale ETag fails, scope expansion is not silent, disabled triggers remain disabled and saving makes zero provider calls; only relevant missing fields block readiness.
checks.evidence: API/config version readback, Profile handoff conflict/retry receipt and independent provider-call counter.

checks.setup: Given owned/adopted profiles, set up/check each; race two project/tenant claims of one native Profile, repeat after unlink, and try foreign sources/wrong roles.
checks.assertion: Ready only with exact permitted role and source-only settings. Concurrent cross-project/tenant claims of one native Profile are denied, including after unlink. Denials create no setup; adopted context/settings remain unchanged.
checks.evidence: Native Profile/role/source permission readback, cross-scope API denial and source-only capability receipts.
checks.phase: Before review controls; live setup WA02/WA07

checks.setup: Lose setup response after native create, restart worker, replay and request owned cleanup alongside an adopted binding.
checks.assertion: One owned Profile is reconciled with original identity; cleanup removes only receipt-owned unreferenced resources after terminal safety checks, preserves adopted setup and records partial cleanup debt.
checks.evidence: Fault trace, independent create count, native owned absence and adopted presence readback.

checks.setup: With one admitted generation, attempt concurrent source-role/profile changes and introduce external profile drift.
checks.assertion: No active run's native scope is overwritten; second active run/change is fenced, drift suspends new admission and retains pinned readback evidence.
checks.evidence: Deterministic transaction/barrier test, pinned profile hash and native drift/readback trace.

stories.title: Pin bounded architecture sources with exhaustive coverage and retention
stories.outcome: Every review names the exact IaC, documents and goals sent for analysis, shows exclusions honestly and keeps those sources available while remote work still needs them.
stories.files: Existing ProductClient/source_manifest and gateway Product snapshot integration; proposed WA source packaging/provider handoff tests and shared source-retention model/migration. WA03 owns retention semantics; #8684 owns Product source APIs; WA07 integrates shared schema/store changes.
stories.contract: Admission pins source RecordRefs/snapshot hashes, byte/file bounds, goals/context and selected-tree coverage. Deterministic archive/manifest maps every selected artifact and entry to component or explicit exclusion; reject unsafe paths, secrets, oversized or unsupported inputs, never execute IaC or silently truncate. Read back immutable private source bytes and provider consumption evidence. Persist tenant/artifact/run hold until remote terminal proof; revoked access hides reuse but does not trigger destructive deletion. No Profile SQL or new crawler.
stories.prerequisite: WA01 must qualify additionalContext/file/byte/role/provider readback semantics; WA02 supplies ready source-only binding. Unknown provider ingestion limits block activation, not local packager/denial tests. WA07 supplies authorized private store/fixtures.

checks.setup: Package mixed IaC/docs/goals at fixed revisions twice, then independently enumerate selected Git trees/doc hashes.
checks.assertion: Identical bytes/hashes; every selected tracked path and deployment/build entry has component or exclusion; remote modules/submodules and unsupported formats are visible gaps. A changed/missing path fails comparison.
checks.evidence: Independent enumeration diff, deterministic archive/manifest digests and complete selected-scope coverage report.
checks.phase: Before review: WA03; live manifest WA07

checks.setup: Try traversal/symlink/duplicate/secret/oversize/foreign-source inputs; for valid input verify private object bytes and provider source receipt.
checks.assertion: Unsafe or unauthorized input cannot reach provider; exact pinned bytes reach qualified provider scope. Upload-only or missing provider consumption evidence cannot pass EC-03.
checks.evidence: Negative byte fixtures, independent store digest, effective read-policy denial and provider ingestion evidence.
checks.phase: Before review + live source qualification: WA03/WA07

checks.setup: Expire local run/snapshot policy while remote state is running/unknown, revoke reader and attempt cleanup; later observe terminal proof.
checks.assertion: Source hold prevents destructive expiry while required; unauthorized reuse is denied; only terminal/policy-safe release permits cleanup. Conflicting mandatory retention rejects admission before Start.
checks.evidence: Controlled-clock retention test, object presence/absence readback, revoked read denial and hold-release receipt.

stories.title: Run native recommendation generations with durable uncertain-outcome recovery
stories.outcome: An admitted review starts promptly, survives interruption without duplicate paid work, and accurately distinguishes local timeout from a generation still running in AWS.
stories.files: Existing admission/dispatcher/work_store, workers/execution and recovery, adapter protocol; proposed adapters/well_architected/generation.py and installed-worker fault tests. WA07 coordinates common worker and PR #9081 changes; retain Security cancellation compatibility.
stories.contract: Commit pinned prepared provider request, stable correlation name/profile/model hash and attempt before Start; disable SDK mutation retries. Immediate after-commit dispatch plus existing bounded SQL recovery handles lost queue sends. Lost Start response reconciles original profile/name/scope identity, never blind retry. Due observation preserves last known native state; unsupported cancellation/local expiry retains source holds and allows later collection. Extend shared terminal-local-state recovery, not just the adapter enum. Native completion starts collection, not a new paid run.
stories.prerequisite: WA01 safe native identity/no-effect semantics, WA02 ready binding, WA03 provider-readable archive/holds. #8698 release transport/factory and WA07 eligible fixture enable installed live fault proof; absence blocks only dependent phase.

checks.setup: Submit an eligible pinned review through gateway and deployed queue/worker, with observation due later.
checks.assertion: Committed intent is dispatched immediately without waiting for sweep; one native generation uses recorded profile/source scope and reaches independently read terminal status/results.
checks.evidence: API-to-SQL/SQS/worker/provider correlation, source receipt and native generation/readback timestamps.

checks.setup: Crash after Start but before SQL receipt, lose SQS acknowledgements, expire leases, delay list visibility and present multiple candidates.
checks.assertion: At most one Start attempt per uncertain run; unique attributable readback reconciles; zero/multiple candidates stay unknown; stale fences cannot commit; SDK retries do not add native calls.
checks.evidence: Independent provider call counter, installed-worker fault journal, SQL attempt/fence readback and native generation list.

checks.setup: Cancel/expire locally during running generation, deny or fail status reads, exhaust observation limit and later restore authorized readback of completion.
checks.assertion: No false remote stop/failure; last successful state/freshness and bounded blocked status persist; sources retained; later result is collected from original generation with zero resubmission.
checks.evidence: Clock-controlled worker trace plus native status, retained-source and late-result readbacks.

checks.setup: Fail collection after a page/SQL write and restart after provider terminal completion.
checks.assertion: Collection resumes by durable cursor/identity; one result version is committed, wrong-generation data rejected, and Start is never called again.
checks.evidence: Page/cursor fixture, result uniqueness readback and independent native call-count trace.

stories.title: Publish attributable recommendations and prove later entitled design reuse
stories.outcome: Users receive source-backed recommendations with honest limitations, and a later authorized design task can use the same version even after owned provider setup is cleaned up.
stories.files: Existing result/findings/triage APIs/models; proposed WA recommendation normalizer/comparison tests; shared SA11 publication worker/models and Context/Insights adapters, coordinated with #8693/#8149. Do not reuse DevOps space-knowledge rows or orchestration tracker outbox as a new result sink.
stories.contract: Paginate profile recommendations, Get each and filter exact generationId; preserve native IDs/raw private artifacts and strict source-only result variant. Independent source/goals comparison records supported/contradicted/not_verifiable/not_checked with real citations. Scope-compatible comparisons only. Durable per-result/version/destination/schema publication keys recover lost acknowledgement without paid reruns. Current source visibility and revocation watermark govern artifacts/query/counts and later reuse.
stories.prerequisite: WA04 native results and WA03 manifest; shared SA11 #8693/Context #8149/Insights owners must expose admitted schema, receipt readback and denied-reuse behavior. Unsupported consumers block publication/EC-07, not result persistence/comparison work. WA07 integrates live later-task proof.

checks.setup: Collect paginated native recommendations with mixed generation IDs, missing citations and known supported/contradicted fixture claims.
checks.assertion: Only attributable generation results enter accepted output; unsupported/missing source evidence is labeled, not invented. Independent verifier compares substantive recommendations against pinned IaC/goals; source-only makes no deployed-state claim.
checks.evidence: Native page/get receipts, normalized version and independent claim-to-source comparison with deliberately wrong-case failures.

checks.setup: Persist result, perform safe owned cleanup, then fail/replay destination publication and lose its acknowledgement.
checks.assertion: Results survive cleanup; each Context/Insights destination eventually has one durable attributable receipt or visible blocked debt; replay reads existing admission and never invokes provider Start.
checks.evidence: Post-cleanup result readback, consumer receipt/recovery and provider call-count trace.
checks.phase: Before review + live consumer proof: WA05/WA07

checks.setup: A distinct later entitled design task queries/uses the versioned review; a foreign actor and subsequently revoked source actor try the same result/query/artifact.
checks.assertion: Later task cites/uses the admitted result revision with retrieval receipt; denied readers receive no derived content or private counts. Upload-only evidence cannot pass.
checks.evidence: Context and Insights consumer receipts, later task retrieval/use trace and controlled deny/revocation readback.

checks.setup: Compare result versions with identical versus changed source/pillar/goal coverage; replay triage from another Product.
checks.assertion: Comparable scope yields attributable diff; incompatible scope returns not_comparable reasons; foreign triage/results are denied without scope leakage.
checks.evidence: API comparison/triage tests with independent expected scope identities and pagination/count denial checks.

stories.title: Expose shared UI CLI MCP reviews and opt-in scheduled admission
stories.outcome: Humans and agents can configure, check, run and read the same review through their preferred client; recurring work happens only when explicitly enabled and admitted.
stories.files: Existing gateway Product frontend, installed cli/adp packaging and MCP/tool catalog transport; shared contracts operation matrix and events/schedules receiver. Proposed Well-Architected service tab and shared adp service/MCP implementation; coordinate SA12–SA14 #8694/#8695/#8696 and WA07. No second public API or scheduler.
stories.contract: Product Services tab and shared adp service/MCP matrix invoke one Product-scoped L5 API. Show inherited configuration, exact source/pillars/readiness, setup receipt, local/provider/freshness state, coverage/results and publication debt. Preserve shared conditional-write/error/JSON receipt semantics. Extend Security-only event service discrimination with scope-bound event/tick deduplication; enabled schedules use common manual admission and current budget/delegation. No native weekly discovery or browser federation copy.
stories.prerequisite: WA01 typed client contracts plus WA04/WA05 run/results; shared client surfaces may still be unimplemented. WA07 supplies served frontend, installed CLI, authenticated MCP and deployed schedule fixture. Missing live eligibility blocks live journeys, not client error-state development.

checks.setup: Use served UI, installed CLI and authenticated MCP to save/check/run/read the same eligible Product review and replay its mutation key.
checks.assertion: Each client sees the same config/binding/run/result revision and errors; one replayed intent, no hidden native calls. Foreign-project requests are denied consistently.
checks.evidence: Three real client journeys, HTTP receipts and independent API/SQL/provider identity readback.
checks.phase: Before review client tests; live WA06/WA07

checks.setup: Leave schedule disabled, then explicitly enable one; replay equivalent ticks/events and revoke current authority or budget.
checks.assertion: Disabled produces zero runs; enabled deduplicates through common admission; revoked/over-budget request creates no native generation. Neither setup nor schedule enables AWS discovery.
checks.evidence: Controlled-clock event replay/SQL receipts, provider count and native profile/settings readback.

checks.setup: Expose unknown/expired/cancel-unsupported, stale monitoring, not-comparable result and publication-blocked states through all clients.
checks.assertion: No client labels local timeout as confirmed AWS cancellation or source-only findings as deployment verification; JSON/exit/error semantics match shared operation matrix.
checks.evidence: Installed-client state/exit assertions and UI/MCP output linked to authoritative API response.

stories.title: Integrate compatible release and prove portable live recovery reuse and cleanup
stories.outcome: Two distinct onboarded projects can use one released service safely, with real native recommendations, recoverable work, reusable results and verified owned-only cleanup.
stories.files: Shared L5 package/SDK lock, migrations, worker factory/infra/tests/live and service runbook; gateway/CodeBuild/platform release inputs and workflow triggers, coordinated with #8698 PR #8932. Own cross-story/common-host integration rather than overwriting sibling designs. File lists are advisory.
stories.contract: Integrate contracts/schema/retention, scoped broker/provider roles, private SQS worker factory and recovery, gateway/front-end/CLI/MCP and consumer publication in compatible batches. Retain normal gateway/frontend auto-deploys and one coordinated L5 worker/infra release per batch. Additive migrations preserve old service rows; rollback disables admissions but retains unknown native work and recoverable results. Verify exact installed artifacts and two non-ADP architectures/goals without code edits or redeployment. Own integration fixes and EC-to-AC evidence closure.
stories.prerequisite: Eligible private fixtures, selected account/exact role and existing policy/budget must be supplied by WA07 with PranavSharma1000 coordination. Shared release #8698/PR #8932, Context/Insights receipt/reuse and catalog readiness are unverified. This issue authorizes no deployment, Support purchase, resource/budget expansion or new human checkpoint by filing.

checks.setup: Release one compatible package/worker/schema/client set; inspect actual main filters, migration/infra ordering, worker factory and rollback with prior service rows.
checks.assertion: Installed release identities agree; gateway/frontend normal triggers preserved; private workers/queue repair work; old Security/DevOps rows and callers remain compatible, rollback retains recovery records. No public Lambda URL.
checks.evidence: Release/workflow/installed-probe receipts, migration compatibility/rollback and effective least-privilege transport readback.
checks.phase: Before review plans/checks; authorized deployment WA07

checks.setup: Run native reviews for two non-ADP projects with distinct IaC/goals using configuration only and the exact same release artifacts.
checks.assertion: Both consume admitted source/context and produce attributable recommendations independently compared to goals; artifact digests unchanged and no platform code edit/redeployment between onboardings. ADP-only or mock evidence fails.
checks.evidence: Two provider/source/result/comparison receipts, private fixture manifests, exact release digests and configuration-change trace.

checks.setup: Exercise foreign tenant/sibling project/source and wrong-role denial, lost Start response/restart, local timeout and owned/adopted cleanup on eligible fixtures.
checks.assertion: No unauthorized provider effect or duplicate generation; remote unknown/running sources retained, adopted resources unchanged; owned terminal cleanup independently absent and results retained.
checks.evidence: Installed-worker fault/deny trace, native ID/call count, source presence, owned absence and adopted/result presence readback.

checks.setup: Complete all client journeys, acknowledge Context/Insights publication and run a later distinct entitled design task plus denied reuse case.
checks.assertion: Same result revision is usable across clients and later task, both consumers acknowledge, denied actor cannot retrieve derived content; cleanup does not erase accepted result.
checks.evidence: Client/API parity, consumer receipts, later retrieval/use and denied-reuse trace at release identity.
checks.phase: Live: WA07 with WA05/WA06 and peer owners

checks.setup: Reconcile every epic/story criterion and resource disposition at tested revisions after the live batch.
checks.assertion: EC-to-AC/scenario evidence complete or explicitly fail/blocked/not-run; costs distinguish ADP accounting, provider/ancillary charges and unknowns; no renewed allowance. Required blocked rows keep epic incomplete.
checks.evidence: Versioned private acceptance/cost/cleanup ledger and sanitized public summary with owners and remaining phase-specific blockers.
